CONFOUNDERS: The dominant failure mode is operational: the trial enrolled only 4 participants (a crossover design requiring 12 sequences of 4 periods each would need substantially more participants) and was terminated before any primary endpoint data could be collected. This is a classic recruitment/feasibility failure — the mechanism was never given a fair test. The 2-week total duration and single-dose crossover design also raise questions about whether the timeframe was appropriate for detecting cognitive effects in Alzheimer's disease, but this is secondary to the enrollment collapse. Because the trial was terminated before any efficacy readout, this qualifies as 'insufficient_information' — there is no usable efficacy signal about the causal chain.
